rv.q: It’s a reminder of how glorious La Cage aux Folles can be when everything clicks.
There are signs that O’Hara is indeed trying some new approaches, but the opening night performance offered more signs that the show, to put it charitably, hasn’t quite come together yet.
Indeed, the enterprise has to be declared entertaining, even if not thoroughly polished to a high gloss.

cn.t: Porter and Brady's tender, affectionate chemistry anchors this joyful Encores! revival, with Herman's life-affirming anthems like "I Am What I Am" and "The Best of Times Is Now" delivering euphoric musical-theater magic.
